CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE
EN CHINE

Shanghai, 9th June 1944.

Sir,

./.
I have the honour to enclose herewith copy
of a letter addressed to a member of my Auxiliary
Staff, Mr. Emil Essig, a Swiss national, warning
him, as well as Mr. Ernst Wurster, of a possible
attempt on their persons by Alfonso Novarro, a
Filipino citizen, or some other Filipinos.

In view of this threat, I would be obliged
if you would take any measure which you may deem
necessary for the protection of the abovementioned
persons.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（印：第一警察局督察处 12 JUNE 1944 上海市）

瑞士驻中国总领事馆

上海，1944年6月9日。

先生：

./.
谨随函附上致我处辅助职员之一、瑞士籍公民 Emil Essig 先生的一封信的副本，信中警告他以及 Ernst Wurster 先生，菲律宾公民 Alfonso Novarro 或其他一些菲律宾人可能对他们的人身进行袭击。

鉴于此威胁，如蒙采取阁下认为必要的任何措施以保护上述人员，本人将不胜感激。

先此致谢，

谨致
敬礼，

（印：第一警察局督察处 1944年6月12日 上海市）

信件副本

瑞士总领事。

致：
上海特别市
第一警察局
警务处长
上 海。

乍浦路78-15号

pages.en:
June 8, 1944.

Mr. Essig
Swiss Consulate General

Dear Sir,

I wish to inform you that, under the leadership
of Mr. Alfonso Navarro, the disloyal Filipinos whose
relief were cut had a secret meeting and had agreed to
go to the Swiss Consulate to do damage and wreck your
place, contending that by stopping their relief, it
clearly indicates that your office is going beyond the
sphere of neutrality. According to Mr. Conrado Uy,
their plan is unwise yet if they insist they can go on
as the Japanese will back them in case it will come to
worse. I wish to warn you and Mr. Hurster to be very
careful and watchful while going to and leaving your
office because of the physical harm they are intending
to inflict.

Mr. Essig, I had known Mr. Alfonso Navarro as a
gangster in Manila before he became a musician. At
present, he is an opium-addict and a desperate man on
account of his financial difficulties. With his
followers as mostly opium-addicts men without reasons,
I want to reiterate once more that please be careful and
watchful. Sir, I know my own people so I hope that you
will try to get some protection for your office and heed
to my warning starting from to-day.

Very respectfully yours,

1
pages.zh:
1944年6月8日。

Essig 先生
瑞士总领事馆

尊敬的先生：

兹通知您，在 Alfonso Navarro 先生的领导下，那些救济被切断的不忠菲律宾人举行了一次秘密会议，并同意前往瑞士领事馆进行破坏和捣毁贵处设施，他们声称停止他们的救济清楚地表明贵处已超出中立范围。据 Conrado Uy 先生称，他们的计划是不明智的，但如果他们执意行事，他们可以继续下去，因为一旦事态恶化，日本人将支持他们。我希望警告您和 Hurster 先生在往返办公室时要非常小心和警惕，因为他们意图造成人身伤害。

Essig 先生，我在 Alfonso Navarro 成为音乐家之前就知道他是马尼拉的一名歹徒。目前，他是一名鸦片瘾君子，并因经济困难而变得铤而走险。由于他的追随者大多是无理性的鸦片瘾君子，我想再次重申，请务必小心和警惕。先生，我了解我自己的同胞，因此希望您能设法为贵处寻求一些保护，并从今天起 heed（注意/听从）我的警告。

此致
敬礼，

1
